legal_privacy_meta_description: What {siteName} collects when you upload a photo and generate a video, and what happens to it.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy covers the photo you upload, the video we generate, your account and your payments on {siteName}.
legal_privacy_collect_body: Your email address and sign-in method; the photos you upload; the videos generated for you; your orders and credit balance; and technical data such as IP address, a signed device cookie and basic request logs, which we use for abuse limits and debugging.
legal_privacy_processors_body: Cloudflare hosts the site, stores the files and runs the database. Stripe processes payments. Google provides optional sign-in and the reCAPTCHA score that protects free tries. Our AI provider receives your photo and prompt in order to render the video. We do not sell personal data.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Uploads are deleted from storage on a short lifecycle rule, currently two days after upload. Generated videos stay in your account until you delete them or ask us to remove them. Account and payment records are kept while the account exists and for as long as tax and dispute handling requires.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: First-party only: a session cookie for sign-in, a signed device cookie that enforces the free-try limit, and an attribution cookie that survives the checkout redirect. No advertising cookies.
legal_privacy_choices_body: Email us to access, export or delete your data. You must be 18 or older to buy credits, and you may upload a child's photo only if you are that child's parent or guardian, or have the parent's or guardian's permission.
legal_terms_meta_description: The rules for using {siteName} to turn a photo into a short dancing video.
legal_terms_intro: These terms cover what {siteName} does, what you may upload, and how credits and refunds work.
legal_terms_service_body: {siteName} turns one photo you upload into a short AI-generated video, for personal use. The output is yours to keep and post, subject to the content rules below and to the terms of the platform you post it on.
legal_terms_content_body: Upload only photos you have the right to use: your own child, or a child whose parent or guardian has given you permission. Do not upload other people's children, anyone in a sexual or exploitative context, or material that infringes copyright. Outputs are AI-generated: label them where a platform requires it, and never present them as real footage of a real event.
legal_terms_credits_body: Credits are sold in packs and do not expire. A render spends its credits when it starts; one video costs the same however long it takes. A failed render is refunded automatically. Unused credits are refundable under the refund policy.
legal_terms_warranty_body: AI output is provided as-is. A render may fail, show artefacts, or fail to keep a likeness; a failed render is refunded and that is the limit of our obligation. We may update these terms, and a material change is published on this page with a new date.
legal_refunds_meta_description: How refunds work for failed renders and unused credits on {siteName}.
legal_refunds_intro: This policy covers a render that fails and credits you bought but did not use.
legal_refunds_failed_body: If a render fails, or we cancel it on our side, the credits return to your balance automatically, usually within a minute. There is nothing to request.
legal_refunds_unused_body: A pack that has not been spent can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. A partly spent pack cannot. Credits bought during a promotion follow the terms shown at checkout.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Email us from the address on the account with the order number and what happened. We reply within two business days.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to report infringing material on {siteName} and how to respond to a takedown.
legal_dmca_intro: This page explains how to report material that infringes your rights, and how to respond if your upload was removed.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Email us with the work you own, the URL of the material, your contact details, a statement of good-faith belief that the use is unauthorised, a statement under penalty of perjury that the notice is accurate, and your signature. We act on complete notices within two business days.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If your upload was removed and you believe it was lawful, email us with the URL, your contact details and a statement under penalty of perjury that the removal was a mistake. We forward complete counter-notices to the original complainant.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: An account that collects repeated valid notices loses upload and generation access; repeated infringement ends the account.
